name: Ikra Shidiqi
description: A naga advisor who betrayed the Sultai's last khan Tasigur to the dragonlord Silumgar and became his first dragonspeaker.

timeline.summary: Ikra Shidiqi betrays the Sultai khan Tasigur to the dragonlord Silumgar and becomes his dragonspeaker.
